title: The Most Common Causes of Fire

blocks.text: The Most Common Causes of Fire
There are a number of causes that may lead to the evolution and spreading of a fire. But with proper measures taken we could reduce the impact.

Fire is a threat in both residential places and workplaces. A fire can result in diverse problems including loss of productivity, financial losses and above all injuries and fatalities. If you are searching for a guide to understand the most common causes of fire, this article can help you.
Understanding the common causes of fire can help in taking necessary preventive measures by resorting to the best fire and safety equipment.
The causes of fire are many both in residential spaces and workplaces. Some of them are enlisted here.

Defective equipment can pose a serious threat when left unnoticed. Loose wires, old equipment that are not maintained properly, sockets etc are dangerous things if not taken care of properly. To erase the chance of getting a fire from the defective equipment it is required to cross-check whether all these electrical equipment are well maintained and regularly tested to ensure it’s functioning and to assure that it isn't a safety hazard.

Whether it is in your home or at work, when we come in contact with flammable materials like paper, wood, cardboard, oil and other flammable liquids, there is a need to ensure that it is managed appropriately. These materials if not handled with care can act as fuel and help even a small fire outbreak to escalate and spread to a larger one. Proper disposal and handling is a must for these flammable materials. Additionally, it is always better to have fire and safety equipment, most importantly a fire extinguisher, in hand.

Many of the devices in both our homes and offices are working electrically and these electrical devices have the potential to start a fire. The most common among them are overheated lightning equipment. The improper usage of electrical devices and its maintenance and overusing of equipment are other chances. It is important that everyone should have proper awareness about how to handle a fire outbreak without becoming panicked.
